title: Mardi Gras balls and social clubs
summary: He describes Carnival krewes and the many social club balls the band played.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Um, I was wondering about Mardi Gras parades.
If you remember any special things you did around Mardi Gras time? Oh, yeah. We, we played for the, all these big, uh, social clubs around, you know.

The balls or the parades or what? Yeah, there was the balls and the parade. The parade. The parade and the ball, yeah. Now, the, of course, in the old days, they had the big, uh, Rex, Momus, Cody, uh. Comus.

And they had those, those were the, the Lanterns. The 12th Night Revelers. And they had all those big balls, see. But then later on, these different social clubs had their balls. And I understand, they, there's about 40 balls in our goals. Yeah. So we got, we got our share. They played down at Washington Tilbury Hall or the Outfield Hall on Camp C. And, uh, the Islander Social Club. Oh, Christ, I can't stick to the name now.
